messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in auth failures + unusual outbound connections from edge cluster us-east-1. Pager firing for #incidents.

oncall-aaron: I'm up. Acknowledging pager — starting triage. Ping @sec_tony @sre_anna @infra_jake.

sec_tony: joining. Any sample traces or header patterns?

sre_anna: summary: last 20m ~980 401s (baseline ~15). Src IPs showing repeated hits: 3.120.45.12, 44.201.98.7. Requests present X-Session-Heart header. Pulling recent proxy logs now.

eng_li: quick log query ran:
```
index=edge-proxy "X-Session-Heart" | top src_ip path by _count
```
shows /v1/chat and /v1/complete as top paths.

sre_anna: sample line: \"ts:\\"2026-03-20T14:02:11Z\\",\\"src_ip\\":\\"3.120.45.12\\",\\"method\\":\\"POST\\",\\"path\\":\\"/v1/chat\\",\\"resp_code\\":401,\\"header_x-session-heart\\":\\"eyJhbGci...\\",\\"ua\\":\\"curl/8.2\\"\"

sec_tony: tokens appearing verbatim in logs and being replayed from external hosts. Likely either leaked debug dump or exfil collector. Need to identify token issuance window and scope.

oncall-aaron: @infra_jake please block egress to 3.120.45.12 and 44.201.98.7. @sre_anna snapshot token-validate hit ratio.

infra_jake: egress rules applied (blocked). Confirmed route update and firewall rules pushed.

sre_anna: validation probe against auth: executed with a sample set. Script: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://auth.internal/v1/validate -d '{"token":"<sample>"}'
```
Result: ~35% of sampled tokens (issued between 2026-03-17 and now) still valid.

sec_tony: recommend immediate scoped rotation for tokens issued in last 72h and build revoke list for tokens observed in logs. We'll need to coordinate force sign-out and notify customers.

oncall-aaron: initiating revocation job across auth/session-store/edge. Tagging affected tenant IDs for CS. ETA to enforcement start: 10m.

cust_success_maya: prepping customer comms for forced sign-out window. Who are top impacted tenants? Need list to prioritize exec outreach.

sre_anna: correlating tenant IDs -> tenants: alpha-sys, beta-analytics, gamma-app show elevated failure counts. Sending to @cust_success_maya DM.

eng_li: temp mitigation: apply per-token throttling on suspect endpoints to reduce replay amplification. snippet: 
```
rate_limit:
  path: "/v1/chat"
  per_token: 2/min
```
Deployed to edge canaries.

legal_elena: preserve all artifacts for forensics (raw logs, S3 objects, CI run logs). Do not delete anything. Loop Legal on customer notices.

sec_tony: runbook: 1) block egress to suspect IPs (done) 2) scoped token rotation and revocation (in progress) 3) audit recent S3 uploads/CI artifacts for debug dumps 4) scrub logs for X-Session-Heart moving forward.

eng_li: found a staging S3 object `session_debug_20260319.txt` in `staging-logs` with world-read ACL changed yesterday. Owner: @dev_sam. Contains header dumps.

dev_sam: that’s my debug dump from local repro. I only tested against staging. I will delete and rotate any keys I used. Sorry, didn't realize headers were included.

sec_tony: mark that upload as probable origin; include in timeline. We'll still rotate tokens and treat as exfil confirmed until proven otherwise.

oncall-aaron: revocation enforcement started at 2026-03-20T14:12:00Z. Tokens minted between 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z flagged. Force-signout job kicked off. Estimated completion 30m.

sre_anna: seeing auth error spike consistent with revocation rollout. No cascading failures reported. P95 latency +12ms, OK.

cust_success_maya: sent preliminary notices to tenant owners (alpha-sys, beta-analytics, gamma-app). Template reviewed by PM.

pm_rachael: pinged for tone. Will join on customer calls if needed.

legal_elena: comms approved with minor edits. Keep Legal cc on replies.

incident-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: INC-20260320-77. Actions: tokens revoked, egress blocked, suspected staging upload origin identified, customer notices dispatched.

sec_tony: Forensics: keep headers, payloads, IPs. Run automated YARA-like scans for known exfil loaders in payloads and object metadata. Also check CI runners for leaked credentials.

eng_li: running scan across CI runs and staging buckets for filenames like `debug`, `session_dump`, `trace`. Found one CI job 2026-03-18 that uploaded `session_dump.txt` -> flagged.

dev_sam: that was the one I uploaded from my laptop via CI runner to staging-logs. I will coordinate rotation and ensure runner credentials rotated.

oncall-aaron: handoff plan: I will stay on channel for a 4h monitoring window. Handoff to day oncall @sre_bella in 45m. Leave runbook and TODOs in incident doc.

sre_bella: (ack) I'll pick up at handoff and monitor post-rotation replays. Please note the revoke list location: /infra/incidents/INC-20260320-77/revokes.txt and runbook steps.

sec_tony: recommended post-incident actions: 1) enforce log scrubbing at proxy 2) deny-by-default S3 ACLs for `*-logs` buckets 3) CI runner credential rotation + artifact retention policy 4) improve SDK examples to avoid printing headers.

oncall-aaron: monitoring shows no new hits to blocked IPs after egress rule. Revocation completion at 14:40Z.

incident-bot: UPDATE: revocation complete. No new replays observed in first 20m. Maintaining P2 status. Will downgrade when 4h clean.

cust_success_maya: coordinating follow-up comms with legal and PM. Proposing a short FAQ and recommended customer steps (re-login, rotate their API keys if suspicious).

legal_elena: preserve all evidence for 90 days. Schedule postmortem in 72h.

sec_tony: will run deeper forensic analysis and confirm no service accounts used. If any SVC tokens compromised, escalate to highest severity.

oncall-aaron: thanks everyone. Channel remains open for monitoring. I'll post final closure note after 4h if stable.
